kamloops.title: Gregor Robertson challenged on the Broadway Construction project
kamloops.description: Fable Diner and SportChek are just two of the most recent businesses to shutter along Broadway near Main Street as construction continues.

kamloops.title: B.C. regional district lifts last of its evacuation orders for Ainslie Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: The Thompson-Nicola Regional District in southern British Columbia has lifted the last of its evacuation orders related to the out-of-control Ainslie Creek wildfire. The regional district says an order has been downgraded to an evacuation alert for 58 addressed properties in the Coldwater and Patchett Road areas.

southeast.title: RCMP investigating trio of suspicious wildfires in Grand Forks, B.C.
southeast.description: Firefighters in Grand Forks, B.C., were called to three wildfires this weekend they say are suspicious.

all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome.
